title: Greek Lamb Skewers
description: A classic Greek recipe featuring tender lamb skewers, perfect for a summer barbecue. Marinated in a mix of olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs, these skewers are sure to impress.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
